title: oso95/scroll-world
claim: oso95/scroll-world — A skill that turn any brand into a scrollable 3D world
why_good: This project taps into the growing demand for immersive brand experiences, allowing companies to showcase their products in a novel way.
value: Brands could pay for customizable 3D environments to enhance customer engagement and drive sales through interactive experiences.
risk: The concept may struggle to gain traction if larger tech companies integrate similar features into their existing platforms.
